[NSTG.4.5] **Per-emit TTL.** Per LHYD, the call's
`retain: 10_min` clause caps a hydrated fact's lifetime
regardless of the schema's default ttl_ns. Assert each
hydrated row with `ds_engine_assert_with_ttl`, passing the call's
retain budget as `ttl_ns_override`; the engine retracts
the row at the per-emit deadline (LHYD.6.2 /
LHYD.10.5.1) even on a LOGICAL schema. A `0` override
falls back to the schema default.
